name: Heat Check
author: Badr-Emil
description: See why your fans are loud: temperatures, the programs that heat the machine, and a switch for the power profile.

barWidget.description: Shows processor, graphics and drive temperatures, explains in plain words what is heating the machine, lets you end the busiest programs and switch the power profile.
